name: Morning Light
title: Get outdoor light after waking.
benefit: Better sleep at night and easier mornings.
subtitle: Light Exposure
rationale: Morning light advances circadian timing, which makes waking easier and moves sleep earlier.

evidence.summary: Morning light advances circadian timing and can improve sleep timing and daytime symptoms.

indications: Sleep timing drifts later across the week.
Mornings start slow and groggy indoors.
Most days start with screens before any outdoor light.
